name: Onikojima Atsushi
source:
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Atsushi is a part of the school's Department of Fine Arts. He is a cool and fine looking guy, who speaks slowly and relaxed. Nobody knows what is on his mind most of the time. He seems to have no interest in the outside world, for he is busy focusing on his own.
